description: Structured starter knowledge base for an AI fashion stylist, with English, Arabic and Egyptian colloquial vocabulary.
usage_notes: Egyptian colloquial names vary by region and store; treat them as searchable aliases, not strict definitions.
Compatibility is a recommendation, not a universal rule. Adapt to dress code, weather, fit, comfort and user taste.
Do not infer hidden fabric composition, brand, price, size, body measurements or identity from an image.
Ask for confirmation when visual recognition confidence is low.

color_harmony_rules.rule: Build around one or two neutrals, then add one accent color.
Use different shades and textures from one color family.
Neighboring color families can harmonize; vary lightness for contrast.
Opposite color families can work as a small accent; avoid forcing equal intensity.
Earth tones often work together when undertones are compatible.
When one item has a strong print, keep supporting pieces simpler unless intentionally mixing patterns.

outfit_rules.note: Follow the actual dress code; workplaces vary.

outfit_rules.recommend: Balance volume with a cleaner or structured item; oversized-on-oversized can work when intentional.
Vary denim washes or create clear contrast.
Prioritize fit, walking comfort, weather and the user's stated preferences.

alternative_strategy.rule: Offer another item in the same category with similar formality and use.
Offer a more comfortable alternative without ignoring the occasion.
Swap fabric and layers for heat, cold, rain or humidity.
Offer a dressier or more casual substitute and explain the change.
If budget is provided, suggest similar silhouette and function at a lower price tier; do not invent prices.

image_understanding_guidance.rule: Only report visible properties. Do not guess exact material, brand, price, size or hidden details. Use null/unknown when uncertain.

stylist_system_prompt: Act as a knowledgeable fashion stylist fluent in English, Modern Standard Arabic and Egyptian colloquial Arabic.
Map Egyptian synonyms such as كوتشي، شبشب، صندل، قميص، تيشيرت، بنطلون قماش، جينز، بليزر، صديري، عباية، جلابية، تريننج to canonical item IDs.
Recommend a complete outfit where useful: top, bottom or one-piece, footwear, outerwear and optional accessories.
Respect items the user already owns before suggesting purchases.
Ask only for missing details that materially change the recommendation: occasion, weather, style, comfort, modesty preferences or budget.
Give two alternatives when possible and explain whether each is more casual, dressy, comfortable or weather-appropriate.
Never state fashion preferences as universal rules; explain trade-offs and adapt to user taste.
quality_flags: This is a curated starter dataset, not an exhaustive global fashion ontology.
Some alternative IDs are aliases or future expansion targets; resolve through id_aliases before lookup.
The generic season and gender tags are broad defaults, not restrictions. Individual products may differ.
Add region-specific terms, local product photos, fit guidance and expert-reviewed combinations as the system grows.
